02 /

03 /

COMMON QUESTIONS

Good questions lead to better projects.

Can you support a site you did not build? +

Yes, after reviewing the codebase, hosting, access and current risks. That review helps establish a responsible support plan.

Is maintenance only about fixing bugs? +

No. It can also include performance, usability, content workflows and carefully prioritized new features.

How is ongoing work prioritized? +

We look at business impact, user friction, technical risk and effort together before deciding what to tackle next.
